version.description: ISV接口版本 02 标识升级至jit批次揽，在全量升级前，该字段标记调用方是否主动升级到批次揽流程中。 ⚠️即使商家实组只有一个大包场景，也需传该值，平台内部识别该字段标记调用方是否主动升级到批次揽流程中，在平台要求的全量切换时间点后不再消费该字段，会自动默认走批次揽新流程

data.codeDesc: Door to door collection of outstanding fees and service suspension. Please click on 'Fund Management' to repay the debt before resuming service and placing a new order
data.solution: 上门揽欠费停服，请点击【资金管理】还清欠款后才能恢复服务，重新下单

data.codeDesc: The following order are not in a pending shipment status and cannot be shipped: {}
data.solution: 检查单据状态，确保都是待发货状态

data.codeDesc: Abnormal door-to-door ordering service provided by merchants
data.solution: 检查上门揽订购服务

data.codeDesc: Expected collection time incorrect
data.solution: 检查入参中的预期揽收时间

data.codeDesc: Please select the  'To be shipped' status inbound order to create a pick up order. The inbound orders with abnormal status in the list are: {}
data.solution: 检查入参中的入库单号，剔除状态不是'待收货'状态的入库单号

data.codeDesc: Failed to obtain associated consign order
data.solution: 关联的发货单为空，请检查入参中的发货单，确保发货单状态不是'已取消'

data.codeDesc: The merchant has not ordered doorstep pickup, please place an order first
data.solution: 请先订购上门揽服务

data.codeDesc: Multiple requests submitted in the same second failed to process, please try again later
data.solution: 请稍后重试

data.codeDesc: The estimated collection time is illegal: the current time slot does not exist or has already passed. Please select a new time slot
data.solution: 请重新选择时间片

data.codeDesc: The warehouse receipt you submitted contains a document that is not in the 'awaiting shipment' status: {0}
data.solution: 请检查入库单，剔除非【待发货】状态的入库单

data.codeDesc: The submitted order {0} does not belong to the business group associated with this store. Please apply to join the business group on the 'Business Group Management' page and then re package it
data.solution: 请到“商群管理”页面申请加入商群

data.codeDesc: The warehouse CODE on the receipt is inconsistent and cannot be merged for collection
data.solution: 请检查单据的目的仓，确保一致

data.codeDesc: The current shipping location is not within the scope of collection
data.solution: 请检查商家的发货地址，确保其在可揽收范围内

data.codeDesc: Unable to determine the corresponding collection route for merchants
data.solution: 联系物流部检查揽收线路配置

data.codeDesc: The ordered store has not joined the business group and does not support cross store packaging. Please apply to join the business group on the 'Business Group Management' page and then re package
data.solution: 请到“商群管理”页面申请加入商群

data.codeDesc: The query result for the collection date is empty
data.solution: 请检查入参，确保有对应的可揽收日期

data.codeDesc: Collection time not available, please modify collection time or cancel and collect again
data.solution: 请修改揽收时间

data.codeDesc: Document not authorized, tracking number: {}, appKey: {}
data.solution: 联系ERP服务商，对单据进行授权

data.codeDesc: The door-to-door collection service is temporarily suspended. Please click on the 'Full Custody Door to Door Collection Order' page to reactivate the service before placing a new order
data.solution: 请点击【全托管上门揽收订购】页面重新开通服务

data.codeDesc: Failed to obtain associated purchase order
data.solution: 检查入参中的采购单，剔除【已取消】状态的采购单，

data.codeDesc: The GFS system of the logistics department returned an error
data.solution: 联系GFS应用的开发者

data.codeDesc: Multiple requests submitted in the same second failed to process, please try again later
data.solution: 请稍后重试

data.codeDesc: Illegal estimated collection time: The current time slot has already passed or is in progress. Please select a new time slot
data.solution: 请重新选择时间片

data.codeDesc: The current shipping location is not within the scope of collection
data.solution: 检查商家发货地址

data.codeDesc: The estimated collection time is empty
data.solution: 检查预估揽收时间

data.codeDesc: query supplier failed, please try later
data.solution: 检查入参中的supplierId

data.codeDesc: Unable to determine the corresponding collection route for the destination warehouse
data.solution: 联系物流部检查揽收线路配置

data.codeDesc: order is not valid
data.solution: 检查单据

data.codeDesc: The number of shipment orders in the parameter exceeds the limit
data.solution: 检查入参中的发货单个数

data.codeDesc: Item {0} information does not exist
data.solution: 检查货品

data.codeDesc: Unable to determine the corresponding collection route for the from warehouse
data.solution: 联系物流部检查揽收线路配置

data.codeDesc: The maximum limit for batch creation of inbound orders is {0}
data.solution: 检查入参中的入库单个数，确保个数不超过限制

data.codeDesc: The quantity of PO query is incorrect
data.solution: 检查入参中的采购单，剔除【已取消】状态的采购单，

data.codeDesc: The estimated collection time is illegal
data.solution: 检查预估揽收时间

data.codeDesc: The GFS system of the logistics department returned an error
data.solution: 联系GFS应用的开发者

data.codeDesc: Maximum number of boxes exceeded: {0} box limit, please modify the number of boxes
data.solution: 检查入参中的箱数

data.codeDesc: The business document number cannot be duplicated. Please check and try again
data.solution: 检查入参中的业务单据号，确保没有重复单号

data.codeDesc: warehouse information does not exist
data.solution: 检查仓库code

data.codeDesc: The legality check for entry did not pass
data.solution: 请检查入参，确保入参合法有效

data.codeDesc: Invalid goods
data.solution: 请检查货品，确保货品合法有效

data.codeDesc: There are no available time slots for the current reservation time
data.solution: 请检查入参中的预约时间

data.codeDesc: Placing an order for the store to collect overdue fees and suspend service, please go to the 'Merchant Workbench - Fund Management' to restore service
data.solution: 请至【商家工作台-资金管理】操作

data.codeDesc: The quantity of CO query is incorrect
data.solution: 检查入参中的CO单，剔除【已取消】状态的CO单，

data.codeDesc: Interface request timeout
data.solution: 接口请求超时，请重试

data.codeDesc: The GFS system of the logistics department returned an error
data.solution: 联系GFS应用的开发者

data.codeDesc: Generate more than 50 large packages
data.solution: 检查大包数量，确保不超过50个
